verses.text: The DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise, Depart, să plece up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the țară of Egipt, to the țară of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’
I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Go to a țară flowing with milk and honey; but I will not să plece up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.
When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

The DOMNUL had i-a zis lui Moise, Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to să plece up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’
The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Now Moise used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it The Tent of Meeting. Everyone who sought the DOMNUL went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
When Moise went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moise, until he had să plecene into the Tent.
When Moise entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and the DOMNUL spoke with Moise. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

The DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Moise i-a zis lui the DOMNUL, Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have a zis, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’ (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He a zis, My presence will să plece with you, and I will give you rest.
Moise i-a zis lui him, If your presence doesn’t să plece with me, don’t carry us up from here.

For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you să plece with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise a zis, Please show me your glory. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He a zis, I will make all my să pleceodness pass before you, and will proclaim the DOMNUL’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.
He a zis, You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL also a zis, Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my mână until I have passed by;
then I will take away my mână, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.
